description:
AirBoxer is a head-tracking boxing dodge game.

Pair your motion earbuds. Tilt your head LEFT or RIGHT to slip a hook. NOD DOWN to duck an uppercut. Don't move into a jab — every opponent telegraphs every punch. The reflex IS the game.


THE OPPONENTS

• SANDBAG — Tutorial. Infinite HP. Verbal callouts on every tell. Learn the rhythm by feel.

• VITRINE BLOOM — Paris. Record 0-99. Slow, telegraphed hooks and a glass jaw. Everyone's first real fight.

• THE WARDEN — Stateville. Record 47-1. Fast telegraphs near the limit of human reaction. The final knockout.


WHY HEAD TRACKING

Modern motion earbuds carry a motion chip that's been quietly shipping in millions of ears for years. Almost no app uses it as primary input. AirBoxer does — every dodge is your actual head moving in real space, not a tap on a screen. Once you've slipped a hook with your head, taps feel small.


DESIGNED FOR THE RING

• 3 distinct opponents with original characters and original 8-bit chiptune music
• Per-fight HP, combo streaks, dodge-zone targeting, knockout sequences
• Retro NES-era arcade aesthetic — bitmap fonts, scanline overlay, drum-roll bell
• Game Center leaderboards: longest dodge streak, total knockouts
• Adjustable motion sensitivity (5 detents) for different necks and play styles
• Pause-on-background so phone calls don't cost you a fight
• Sound + haptics toggles
• Built for iPhone, iOS 16+, with compatible motion earbuds


NO ADS. NO TRACKING. NO IAP.

AirBoxer is a one-time premium purchase. No ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no analytics. The app collects nothing — your earbuds' motion is read locally, used in real time, and discarded.


A LOVE LETTER TO 8-BIT BOXING

Inspired by a 1987 NES boxing classic. All characters in AirBoxer are original; the game is not affiliated with or endorsed by any other rights-holder. The slow telegraphed wind-ups of the 1987 arcade era happen to map almost exactly to what earbud motion sensing can deliver today — that coincidence is the entire game.

Pair your earbuds. Slip the punches. Don't blink.
promotionalText: Pair your motion earbuds. Tilt your head to slip hooks. Nod to duck uppercuts. Premium. No ads, no tracking, no IAP — just you, the dodge, and the ring.
